checks.message: Every banked leg observes its origin departure window
Spoke arrivals precede hub departures by 40 minutes
Every generated bank contains both arrivals and departures

limitations: Bank placement assigns local clock times to proposed hub service but does not yet join those legs into aircraft routes.
Non-hub point-to-point and focus-city flying remains untimed until the routing stage can place it around banked work.
Gate capacity, RON placement, route continuity, and flight numbering remain mandatory downstream checks.
